goal: Find minimal mathematical axiom/resource beyond the independent-future CPU no-go, with a rigorous formal distinction between backwards causal intervention and purely observational predictability.

antecedents.result: R9 exact Q(sqrt2) OCB process-matrix existence proof and forward-only independent future no-go

antecedents.relation: Vilasini-Colbeck hypothetical jamming, NSS vs NSC operational task; the R10 parity family is NOT a reconstruction of the full paper or a novel certified physical protocol

theorem.family: For x,z,b in {0,1}, 0<=eta<=1: P_eta(x,z,b)=[1+eta*(-1)^(x XOR z XOR b)]/8
theorem.proof_technique: Exact coefficient matching in Q[eta] for all eight joint cells; every term affine in eta; five rational examples for cross-check; no floating point
theorem.result_1: Two causal structures generate the identical observational joint P_eta for all real eta in [0,1], even eta=1.

forward_model.upstream: X and Z independent Bernoulli(1/2); N independent Bernoulli with P(N=0)=(1+eta)/2
forward_model.late_equation: B = X XOR Z XOR N
forward_model.chronological_meaning: All early X,Z exist before the late generated B. Strong forward-origin control, NOT a future message.
forward_model.under_do_B: Intervening to externally fix B leaves early joint P(X,Z)=1/4, TV between do(B=0),do(B=1) equals 0

backward_formal_model.exogenous: B,X independent Bernoulli(1/2); N independent noise with P(N=0)=(1+eta)/2
backward_formal_model.equation: Z = X XOR B XOR N
backward_formal_model.computational_order: CPU must supply B before generating Z; this is not actual temporal retrocommunication
backward_formal_model.under_do_B: P(X=x,Z=z|do(B=b))=[1+eta*(-1)^(x XOR z XOR b)]/4; joint total variation between do(B=0),do(B=1) equals eta

theorem.shared_single_marginals: P(X=0|B=b)=P(Z=0|B=b)=1/2 for all b, eta, so marginal no-signalling alone cannot exclude joint correlations.

proof_results.observational_mutual_information: I(B;X,Z)=1-h_2((1-eta)/2), bits, for the symmetric binary channel
proof_results.nonidentifiability_limit: Observation of an entire P(X,Z,B), including perfect parity, cannot identify arrow direction without an external intervention/causal assumptions.

global_two_boundary_filter.implication: This calculation is an ordinary late-conditioned postselection model; it cannot send information to a complete immutable early ledger.

impossible_joint_assumptions: Early record is immutable and generated from complete earlier information R
Later B is independent of entire earlier R and externally free
No backward resource, no hidden shared source, no selected/removed trials
minimal_axiom_gap.logic: Those four assumptions contradict the probability factorization P(R,B)=P(R)P(B). To achieve eta>0, at least one must fail. Ordinary forward model violates late B joint exogeneity; backwards-formal model takes B as prior computational input; global selection violates all-attempt preservation.
minimal_axiom_gap.result_type: Logical necessary condition / observational equivalence theorem, not a time machine.

future_research.priority: Identify a nontrivial causal resource with explicit do(B) semantics that is not mathematically implementable by ordinary forward computation of already-fixed early records, while proving no forbidden filtering or hidden common causes.
future_research.mathematical_test: Compare interventional, not just observational distributions; derive a no-go or existence theorem for resource closure under composition, independent late settings and exact chronology.
future_research.physical_claim_limit: Without a physical realization or an independently defined axiom connecting the model to the actual world, mathematical consistency does not establish time reversal in nature.
